punchline: Twelve wins in six seasons, and he could still name his flaw exactly.
thirty_sec: Bill Campbell coached Columbia football from 1974 to 1979 and went 12-41-1. He later told Fortune his flaw was never asking players to put football above everything: a precise confession, not an excuse.
question: What one thing did you never actually ask of the people on your last failed effort?
key_contrast: A vague bad stretch versus one named request held back.
